Title: Event-driven Java with Spring Cloud Stream Binder for Azure Event Hubs is now available

Body.Content:
Event-driven Java with Spring Cloud Stream Binder for Azure Event Hubs is now available. Spring Cloud Stream provides a binder abstraction for popular message broker implementations. It provides a flexible programming model built on already established and familiar Spring idioms and best practices, including support for persistent pub/sub semantics, consumer groups, and stateful partitions. Now, developers can use the same patterns for building Java apps with Event Hubs.
